rules.statement: Long, continued, undisturbed, and uninterrupted possession by a co-owner is insufficient to counter the presumption of one co-owner possessing for the benefit of all other co-owners unless there are overt acts indicating an intention to oust the other co-owners.
rules.supporting_quote: "Whether ouster may be presumed from long, continued, undisturbed, and uninterrupted possession depends on all the circumstances in each case. (vide Siyadoris v. Simon)."

meta.parties: Maria Fernando and Another v. Anthony Fernando
